item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_koi.lore.0: Bred for centuries for its red and white patches.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_goldfish.lore.0: A carp, tamed in China over a thousand years ago.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_pop_eyed_goldfi: Its telescope eyes see poorly, but look magnificent.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_ranchu_goldfish: No back fin, a round belly and a raspberry crown.
Tiny and tough; some live in puddles that dry up.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_crawfish.lore.0: Walks backward faster than it walks forward.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_soft_shelled_tu: Leathery shell, snorkel nose, quick temper.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_snapping_turtle: Hunts at night with a hooked beak. Keep fingers clear.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_tadpole.lore.0: A frog in the making, all head and tail.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_freshwater_goby: Clings to stones with its belly fins.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_loach.lore.0: Feels the weather change and wriggles before storms.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_giant_snakehead: Breathes air and guards its young fiercely.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_bluegill.lore.0: A dark blue flap behind the gills gives it the name.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_tilapia.lore.0: Raises its young in its mouth.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_pond_smelt.lore: Caught through the ice in winter.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_guppy.lore.0: Males wear tails of every colour.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_neon_tetra.lore: Its blue stripe glows in dark jungle water.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_mitten_crab.lor: Furry claws, as if it wore mittens.
Its flesh smells faintly of melon.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_cherry_salmon.l: Runs upriver when the cherry trees bloom.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_char.lore.0: Lives in the coldest lakes; pale spots on a dark back.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_golden_trout.lo: Found only in high, cold mountain streams.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_stringfish.lore: The giant salmon of Siberian rivers.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_salmon.lore.0: Leaps waterfalls to spawn where it was born.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_king_salmon.lor: The biggest of the Pacific salmon.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_nibble_fish.lor: Nibbles dead skin off your feet, if you let it.
Glides through flooded forests on tall fins.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_betta.lore.0: A fighting fish in a ball gown of fins.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_rainbowfish.lor: Blue up front, orange behind, brighter when happy.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_arowana.lore.0: Jumps from the water to snatch insects off branches.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_dorado.lore.0: The golden tiger of South American rivers.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_gar.lore.0: A living fossil with a needle-toothed beak.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_arapaima.lore.0: A giant that gulps air at the surface; its tail glows red.
Has lungs, and a row of little flags down its back.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_sturgeon.lore.0: Older than the dinosaurs; armour plates instead of scales.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_black_bass.lore: Ambushes anything that fits in its huge mouth.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_pike.lore.0: A patient ambush hunter with a duck-bill snout.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_sea_butterfly.l: A snail that swims with two little wings.
The father carries the eggs in his pouch.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_surgeonfish.lor: A scalpel-sharp spine hides by its tail.
A false eye near its tail fools hunters.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_napoleonfish.lo: A giant wrasse with a hump like a bicorne hat.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_zebra_turkeyfis: Lionfish: every stripe and spine is a warning.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_blowfish.lore.0: Puffs into a spiny ball when frightened.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_puffer_fish.lor: Fugu: a delicacy, and deadly if cut wrong.
Armoured scutes run along its side.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_barred_knifejaw: Crunches sea urchins with a parrot-like beak.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_sea_bass.lore.0: Hunts the surf where rivers meet the sea.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_dab.lore.0: A flatfish that lies on its left side, both eyes up.
Changes colour to match the sea floor.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_squid.lore.0: Changes colour in a blink; ten arms, three hearts.
Gapes from its crevice, a second set of jaws in its throat.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_ribbon_eel.lore: Electric blue and yellow, with flared nostrils like flowers.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_tuna.lore.0: A warm-blooded torpedo that never stops swimming.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_blue_marlin.lor: Spears through baitfish with its bill.
Leaps from the surf to grab seabirds.
Blazes gold, green and blue, then fades in minutes.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_ray.lore.0: Glides over the sand on wide wings; mind the barbed tail.
Its toothed snout has whiskers to feel for prey.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_hammerhead_shar: Its wide head scans the sand like a metal detector.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_great_white_sha: The ocean's top hunter; it smells blood from far away.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_whale_shark.lor: The biggest fish in the sea eats only plankton.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_suckerfish.lore: Hitches rides on sharks with a sucker on its head.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_football_fish.l: An anglerfish: its glowing lure draws prey into the dark.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_oarfish.lore.0: A silver ribbon longer than a bus, crowned in red.
Looks up through a see-through head with green tube eyes.
item.aftrhrs.arcana_fish_coelacanth.lore: Thought extinct for 66 million years, until 1938.
